description: Solana wallet intelligence: holdings, activity, counterparties, programs. One-call Solana wallet profile: SOL and SPL/Token-2022 holdings with USD values (top 25 by value), total USD, recent activity (last 100 signatures: count, failure rate, first/last seen, tx per day), programs used with labels (Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Pump.fun, Meteora, Drift...), top counterparties from the last 15 transactions, and a simple wallet type (bot-like / trader / holder / inactive). Free public data, deterministic, no LLM. Cheaper than comparable Solana wallet-intel APIs.
